brv_fortune.m: Welcome to my house. Please come in.

brv_fortune_10.m: What has brought you to me? It looks like you might need my help.
r: So you are the one who ordered a 'Crystal Globe'?

brv_fortune_20.m: I can see what others can't see.

brv_fortune_300.m: Yes, that would be good. I already have an idea. But not now. Please come back later and ask me again.

brv_fortune_40.m: I feel that you are on a search... at the beginning of a long and dangerous search for a relative of yours.
r: I am impressed. Can you tell me more about my brother Andor or me?
That is too expensive for me.

brv_fortune_andor_10.m: I see you talking to your brother, somewhere far from here in a big city. Feygard or Nor City, I think.

brv_fortune_andor_30.m: Your brother is in league with dark forces.

brv_fortune_andor_31.m: He needs your help. Something horrible ... argh.

brv_fortune_andor_35.m: I can't see more. My view seems to be blocked.

brv_fortune_back_10.m: Welcome back. I see that you bring me interesting things that have fallen from the sky.
r: The pieces that I have found in the area of Mt. Galmore? Yes, I have them with me.

brv_fortune_back_12.m: Sigh. I know many things. How often do I still have to prove it?
r: Well, OK. What about my fallen stones collection?

brv_fortune_back_20.m: You can't do anything useful with them. Give them to me and I'll give you a kingly reward.
r: Here, you can have them for the greater glory.

brv_fortune_back_30.m: Thank you. Very wise of you. Indeed. Let - your - wisdom - grow ...

brv_fortune_back_50.m: Look here in my chest with my most valuable items, that could transfer their powers to you.

brv_fortune_back_52.m: Which one do you want to learn more about?

brv_fortune_back_61.m: Your hand steadies with celestial clarity. Touching the item will permanently increase your weapon accuracy.
r: Sounds great - I choose this one. [Touch the item]
Let me have a look at the other items.

brv_fortune_back_61b.m: A good choice. Do you feel it already?

brv_fortune_back_62.m: Wanderer's Vitality. You carry the strength of the sky inside you. After touching this item, you will begin to learn how to improve your overall health faster.
r: Sounds great - I choose this one. [Touch the item]
Let me have a look at the other items.

brv_fortune_back_62b.m: A good choice. Do you feel it already?

brv_fortune_back_65.m: Very down-to-earth. You will have more success in financial matters.
r: Sounds great - I choose this one. [Touch the item]
Let me have a look at the other items.

brv_fortune_back_65b.m: A good choice. Do you feel it already?

brv_fortune_back_66.m: You move as if guided by starlight. Touching this item will permanently improve your abilities to avoid being hit by your enemies.
r: Sounds great - I choose this one. [Touch the item]
Let me have a look at the other items.

brv_fortune_back_66b.m: A good choice. Do you feel it already?

brv_fortune_back_68.m: From the sky to your hilt, strength flows unseen. Touching the item will permanently let you refresh faster after a kill in a fight.
r: Sounds great - I choose this one. [Touch the item]
Let me have a look at the other items.

brv_fortune_back_68b.m: A good choice. Do you feel it already?

brv_fortune_back_69.m: Touching the item will permanently increase your awareness of unearthy items.
r: Sounds great - I choose this one. [Touch the item]
Let me have a look at the other items.

brv_fortune_back_69b.m: A good choice. Do you feel it already?

brv_fortune_choice.m: Anything more I can help you with?
r: Please tell me something that you can see about me or my brother Andor. [Give him 100 gold]
I don't have 100 gold to pay you.
Are you the one who ordered a 'Crystal Globe'?

brv_fortune_come_back_later.m: I am tired and can't see anything new now. If you come back in a little while maybe I can tell you more.

brv_fortune_come_back_much_later.m: I told you all I can see for now. But you can come back to me in a few months when you have had new experiences.

brv_fortune_end_10.m: Then goodbye. I know you will return some time in the future.

brv_fortune_hero_10.m: I see you walking up a path on a mountain. Beware! There is something waiting for you ahead. I see you being attacked by monsters and they kill you.

brv_fortune_hero_130.m: I see a man pacing up and down in a little house. He seems to be waiting for someone.
r: That must be my father Mikhail, he is waiting for me and my brother!

brv_fortune_hero_131.m: Then go and get your brother and go home to him.

brv_fortune_hero_30.m: I see a thief. He will take something from you.

brv_fortune_hero_70.m: I see you picking up a lot of coins from a hole in the ground. Can it be behind your father's house?

brv_wh_delivery_brv_fortune.m:
Ah yes, I need a new one. My current crystal globe has become a bit cloudy - otherwise I would of course have seen that you would bring me a new globe.
Here is the gold for it.
r: Do you want to try the crystal ball with me to see if it works?

brv_wh_delivery_brv_fortune_10.m: You say you want me to help you?
